items.name: News check
items.what: An AI model (Claude) used to read gaming news twice a day and suggest changes. It's paused for now to save money, so new releases and restocks are added by hand.

items.name: Posts on X
items.what: Posting to X costs money, about 2 cents a post (and $0.20 with a link), so I stopped. Bluesky and Discord are free and still get every post.
